name: Agnes Lowe
title: The Librarian
perk: Wisdom flows 20 % faster in your realm.
story: Agnes kept the reading room of the Härmälä lending library for thirty years, until a book came back with more pages than it left with. She has been counting them since.

name: Tobias Wren
title: The Surveyor
perk: Every Watchtower sees one ring further.
story: Tobias mapped the shoreline for the county and found the lake a metre wider every spring, though no water rose. His theodolite now points at things that are not on any map.

name: Mara Quill
title: The Dockworker
story: Mara unloaded timber barges on Pyhäjärvi until the night a crate answered back. She still has the crowbar, and she still knows what a fair day's lumber costs.

name: Elias Dunmore
title: The Medium
perk: Anomalies show themselves one ring beyond your ground.
story: Elias held séances for paying guests and faked every one of them, until the evening the table rapped back in a voice none of them had brought. Now he listens for free.
